description: rebaseWhen is 'auto', not the preset's 'behind-base-branch': this repo has a merge queue, so a PR need not be up to date to enqueue, and forced rebases would re-run the full matrix on every open PR each time main moves.
type-plus 8.x is a prerelease line and latest deliberately stays on 7.x.
ignoreUnstable only blocks stable -> unstable, so once a range is already on a
prerelease every new beta reads as a patch and automerges. Pin the ceiling instead.

packageRules.description: Storybook 10.5 supports vitest ^3 || ^4 (@storybook/addon-vitest) and vite <=8; lift when Storybook supports vitest 5.

The published packages peer on react ^16 || ^17 || ^18 and Renovate would rewrite those peer ranges to ^19, dropping consumers; @headlessui/react 2 also needs react >=18. Lift when the supported React range is raised.
@headlessui/react 2 requires react ^18 || ^19 but react-freedom supports and tests on react 16. Lift when the supported React range is raised.
